nodes.name: Past-Life Savings
nodes.desc: Coins you hid in a hollow tree three lifetimes ago.

nodes.name: Born Gifted
nodes.desc: A mind that remembers how to learn.

nodes.name: Hardy Soul
nodes.desc: A body tempered by lives of hardship.

nodes.name: Heavenly Affinity
nodes.desc: Your soul calls to the Heavenly root.

nodes.name: Righteous Vow
nodes.desc: You vow to protect the weak. You start each life as a good soul (karma 65). While your karma is 60 or higher you are blessed, but restraint dulls your edge.

nodes.name: Mercy
nodes.desc: While good: the world heals you. Always: you refuse cruel shortcuts, so cultivating is slower.

nodes.name: Heavenly Grace
nodes.desc: While good: the heavens smile on your breakthroughs. But the righteous are watched: karma you lose is lost 1.5 times over.

nodes.name: Living Saint
nodes.desc: While good: a radiant, resilient body and mind. Always: you have forsworn killing blows.

nodes.name: Demonic Vow
nodes.desc: You vow to take what you want. You start each life as a wicked soul (karma 35). While your karma is 40 or lower you gain terrible power, but fate turns on you.

nodes.name: Blood Tempering
nodes.desc: While wicked: savage strength and a body that feeds on slaughter. Always: you leave yourself open.

nodes.name: Dominion
nodes.desc: While wicked: you draw qi from fear. Always: redemption is hard, so good karma you gain is halved.

nodes.name: Overlord
nodes.desc: While wicked: overwhelming power. Always: the heavens hate you, and your body wastes.

nodes.name: Vow of Balance
nodes.desc: You vow to walk the middle path. You start each life at karma 50, and swings in your karma are softened. While your karma stays between 41 and 59 you think clearly, but a detached heart fights without fire.

nodes.name: Harmony
nodes.desc: While balanced: ease of body and mind. Always: you hold back your qi.

nodes.name: Middle Dao
nodes.desc: While balanced: deep meditation and sharper breakthroughs. Always: you rely on stillness over defense.

nodes.name: Sage of Equilibrium
nodes.desc: While balanced: perfect clarity and a long, quiet life. Always: no blazing strength, and fortune is aloof.
